entities.name: MCCH information acquisition procedure
entities.description: Procedure applied by the UE to acquire MBS broadcast configuration information broadcasted by the network. Used by MBS capable UEs interested in receiving MBS broadcast services.

entities.name: MBSBroadcastConfiguration
entities.description: Message containing MBS broadcast configuration information sent from network to UE.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC idle state where UE can perform MCCH information acquisition.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC inactive state where UE can perform MCCH information acquisition.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC connected state where UE can perform MCCH information acquisition when specific conditions are met.

entities.name: Active BWP with common search space configured by searchSpaceMCCH
entities.description: Condition required for RRC_CONNECTED UEs to apply MCCH information acquisition procedure.

entities.name: MBS capable UE
entities.description: Property indicating UE capability to receive MBS broadcast services.

relations.description: MCCH information acquisition procedure involves receiving MBSBroadcastConfiguration message
Procedure can be applied when UE is in RRC_IDLE state
Procedure can be applied when UE is in RRC_INACTIVE state
Procedure can be applied when UE is in RRC_CONNECTED state with specific conditions
RRC_CONNECTED state requires active BWP with common search space configured by searchSpaceMCCH for MCCH acquisition
Procedure applies to MBS capable UEs interested in receiving MBS broadcast services
